body: This movie didn't bored me even for a bit. Its authentic acting and flawless expression of every actor is really impressive. Best Romantic tragedy movie ever. Monpura can not be out of list of the best film in domestic film industry. Not to mention the four National Film award in Five category. Including the best film. It is also remade in Kolkata under the name ' Achin pakhi '.
Monpura is a romantic tragedy film set in rural Bangladesh. This movie's songs are awesome.

Almost every romantic film has a good ending and like provides zero to none reality. This movie is a romantic tragedy film set in 2009,but i watched this at 02/03/2024,very late but I'm glad i did. Masterpiece of a story and contains a solid message for our society. I just can't express how good the songs are but gonna say one thing, the legendary folk music of Bangladesh is included here. Props to the cinematography as well and chanchal chowdhury(his first film) along with fazlur rahman babu nailed their positions. The film portrays the rural side of bangladesh impeccably in every way possible. Man, i wanna go to monpura... The plot is about a man named shonai,working as a house assistant of rich family who gets blamed for a murder which was done by the landlord's mentally impaired son. Then he was left stranded on an island named monpura just to take the blame and live far so that the police couldn't catch him. After that you'll get to experience his livelihood and see how badly his fortune shapes up in the end.

Honestly this film needs no explanation and i would prefer someone directly watching it so WATCH THIS MASTERPIECE!

At about Mid 2008, Bangladesh went through this amazing Movie revival, Everyone literally couldn't wait for the release of this highly anticipated movie starring Chanchal and Farhana. I guess it really didn't live up to its expectations, at least to me.

To begin with the stories potential was completely lost, it was a one of a kind story but there wasn't really much of plot of character development going on. The movie was just a whole collection of one beautiful shot after another. Even though it was a love story there wasn't much of development there.

Now lets go to the good bits, the imagery and obscure dream sequence towards the end was amazing. To top it up and what has probably been the saving grace for the movie was the music. Yes Arnob's music can single handedly make yous it through this movie. the classic titles like 'jao pakhi' and shonar moina paki are still alive among the crowds.

Even then Monpura has proved a major movement for Bangldeshi Movie revival and has safely broken all records set by Bangladeshi movies in the last 50 years. This one's still going down in history. Good watch if you don't expect much

I think, This is the best Bangali movie. I saw this movie in 2009 and i was crying when i saw. its a mind blowing Romantic movie. Chanchal acting was awesome in this movie. overall, It's the best Bangla movie I have ever seen. The songs were the best . Fazlur Rahman Babu sang some songs in his melodious voice. You can't imagine how natural they were. His song "Nithua Pathare" is one of my favorite song. I loved this film and would appreciate if this type of films are created further . An awesome love story that made my heart blow every second when i watched. The eternal beauty of the Bangali woman in a sari is depicted in the movie. The pleats are not once misplaced nor is her "kajol" smudged. The work of the camera in bringing in the effects of sun and rain is commendable . The songs, which were already a big hit in Dhaka before the movie was released, added to the film's overall aesthetic quality.
